presets.label: Motion graphic
presets.description: Pure animated shapes and type, no story: a message told by how things move.
presets.hints: No characters and no scenes: type, shapes and motion carry the message. One strong idea; every shot is a variation of one visual system.

presets.label: 2D story
presets.description: A small story with a beginning, a turn and an end, told in scenes.
presets.pacing: unhurried, with one fast moment at the turn
presets.hints: Tell it as scenes with a beginning, a turn and an end. Give the turn its own shot. Keep text short: pictures tell the story, a caption or two supports it.

presets.label: Explainer
presets.description: Explains one idea step by step with simple visuals.
presets.hints: One idea per shot, in the order a newcomer needs them. Open with the question the viewer has, end with the one thing to remember. Show, then say.

presets.label: Quote or tip card
presets.description: A short animated card: one quote or one tip, designed to be read in seconds.
presets.hints: One sentence only, large, with plenty of room. Two or three shots at most; hold the full sentence long enough to read it twice.

presets.label: Data highlight
presets.description: One number or a small comparison, shown as a chart.
presets.pacing: brisk to the number, then a pause on it
presets.hints: Include a chart shot that shows exactly the numbers in the brief, drawn from those values and no others. Do not invent or round numbers. Give the key number its own shot and hold it.

presets.label: Promo
presets.description: Shows a product or an offer: a hook, the benefit, a call to action.
presets.pacing: fast, with a clear last beat
presets.hints: Hook in the first second, one benefit per shot, and a final shot with the call to action and the logo if one was uploaded. Do not claim anything the brief does not say.
